title: Receiver Preamp
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Receiver_Preamp.md
text: Receiver preamplifier, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Gain (dB)} sets the gain of receiver, {Loss factor (dB)} sets the loss factor of receiver, {Noise specification method}, {Noise power (W)}, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the noise figure of receiver, {Reference temperature (K)} sets the reference temperature of receiver, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Enable enabling signal input} adds input to specify enabling signal, {Enable phase noise input} adds input to specify phase noise and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: TR
ports.summary: Enable enabling signal logical-valued scalar | scalar

params.name: Noise specification method
params.values: Noise specification method Noise temperature (default) | Noise power

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sampling rate of signal 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Enable enabling signal input
params.values: Add input to specify enabling signal off (default) | on

params.name: Enable phase noise input
params.values: Add input to specify phase noise off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
